programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton

He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: City Zoo S1 - "Rhino’s"

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 4"

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 5"

programme.desc: Policing langurs patrol Delhi’s streets and the Holi festival of colour interrupts Zamir’s attempt to take over control of Galta temple.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "MASTERS OF DISGUISE"
programme.desc: These creatures share an amazing trait, the ability use the environment surrounding them to hide in plain sight, to virtually disappear and be utterly camouflaged.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "LETHAL & POISON"
programme.desc: These creatures all utilize venom and poison to attack, defend and hunt, with devastating results.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "SPITS & STINGS"
programme.desc: These creatures have evolved to incorporate spitting and stinging into their deadly arsenal for surviving in the wild.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "!Khwa ttu"
programme.desc: Swati walks in the footsteps of the san, the early hunter gatherers of southern Africa. Come to !Khwa ttu, to learn about their history, culture and why they are some of the world’s first passionate conservationists.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Kelp Forest"
programme.desc: Enter the underwater golden forests and walk the beaches between the intertidal zones as Swati discovers the amazing but fast depleting biodiversity of the world's wildest coastline in the cape of storms.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Leopards"
programme.desc: Walk with leopards as Swati travels to the Cederburg mountains to learn about the cape leopard, to question what puts leopards in conflict with people and what the solutions to this conflict might be?

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Agulhas"
programme.desc: Cape Agulhas is the true meeting place of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, a place of immense cultural and natural value. Tali searches for answers to her burning questions about establishing new parks and the roles communities play in this process.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cedarberg Biodiversity"
programme.desc: Using a novel conservation model, the Greater Cedarberg Biodiversity Initiative is ensuring that the land is used in an efficient way, with the land and its inhabitants work in harmony. Tali investigate the various ways being used to achieve this.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programme.desc: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Clash of the Titans"
programme.desc: The rains bring new life. Lush new grass is saving the 58 elephant families from hunger. An extraordinary annual reunion brings hundreds of elephants together in scenes of celebration, play and romance.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "The Drama of Big Ed"
programme.desc: Nine months of drought have given way to longed-for rains. The elephants now have enough to eat. Echo is taking the family on a day out to the Snipe River. Isaiah’s spear wound needs urgent treatment. But the elephants are ruining new crops.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Cynthia's Choice"
programme.desc: After months of hunger, Echo’s family are enjoying good times. The matriarch and her family are dustbathing at the safe home where Echo shelters her young. Even when they run to defend themselves, they are only pretending to be attacked!

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Gentle Giants"
programme.desc: For this episode we will travel to the Entabeni Safari Conservancy where a special family of African elephant awaits relocation. The family will be moved from a private conservation area as they have reached the carrying capacity of that area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Impala"
programme.desc: With a high reproduction rate that leads to large numbers on reserves and are the staple diet for predators that keep their numbers in check. See how these highly adapted and unique animals get loaded and gently treated to “migrate” to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "White Rhino"
programme.desc: Another member of Africa’s Big 5 - the white rhino. Once on the brink of extinction, and today thanks to the conservation and breeding strategies, there are enough to relocate to other nature reserves to ensure the survival of this unique species.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Raptors"
programme.desc: Many of the larger breeds of raptors are now endangered or vulnerable, particularly eagles, vultures and larger owls as they require large, specialized habitats. Though they may be soaring high now, the future doesn’t bode well for the great raptors.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Apes"
programme.desc: All great apes are highly endangered partly due to hunting and illegal pet trade, but mainly due to shrinking habitats. Sitting in the tree tops and jungles is a reminder of our past and our responsibilities for the future.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Spiders"
programme.desc: Commonly feared, spiders nevertheless persist in every part of the world in great numbers. Spiders are among the biggest groups of invertebrates with over 43,000 species.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Death by Viper"
programme.desc: Back-to-back cold winters have been keeping Florida’s Burmese python population in check so the hunters head to Costa Rica to tangle with the region’s deadliest venomous snakes and soon find themselves on an American crocodile rescue mission.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Amazon Anaconda"
programme.desc: Putting everything on the line, the hunters head to Peru where they go off-road and off the map in search of the mighty green anaconda. Shawn has spent more than a decade exploring the jungles of Peru, buying land, and building a home away from home.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Stalking the Anaconda"
programme.desc: After tracking down the green anaconda in Peru’s Amazon basin, the hunters are determined to find another rare prize – the legendary black caiman. These elusive predators can grow up to 18 feet long, and their jungle habitat is too dangerous.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "Shark Mission"
programme.desc: Ed and Dunc launch a post-lockdown mission to restock their aquarium, while Rick uses a pub forklift to weigh a massive Rottweiler.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "The Trip of Two Turtles"
programme.desc: Dr. Katy coordinates the release of two endangered Hawksbill turtles, an amputee pup beats the odds, and Ed sources sustainable squid.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "A Dingo get DNA-ed"
programme.desc: A Great Dane steps up for a critical blood transfusion in the clinic, while Rick tracks down a wild dingo in the outback for a DNA test.

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "The Lucky Ones"
programme.desc: An uplifting celebration highlights inspiring rescue journeys, tracking the survival stories of resilient dogs like Miss Martha and Remo.

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "Detroit Dog Rescue"
programme.desc: Detroit Dog Rescue works tirelessly to transform neglected urban animals, prepare them for forever homes, and empower them to go be great.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Animal Athletes"
programme.desc: Discover high-performing creatures that can jump, dive, dunk, and pass to claim the title of ultimate animal athlete.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Dog 101"
programme.desc: Celebrate our favorite four-pawed friends, highlighting unique dog breeds that range from massive bodies to giant ears.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "World’s Showiest Animals"
programme.desc: Examine the wacky, colorful, and amazing ways that showy critters grab attention and show off in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 7"
programme.desc: Our wildlife team is in the line of fire once again when they become trapped in the middle of a rhino sandwich. Johan the vet has a rather tricky operation to perform. He needs to give one of our rescued lions a vasectomy.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 8"
programme.desc: Johan crash tackles an adult cheetah after it fails to succumb to the tranquilizer and almost ends up falling asleep on the electric fence. Melvin, our baby giraffe is heading out into the bush to sample leaves for the first time.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 9"
programme.desc: We need to capture five lions to move to another game reserve. Out on the reserve we manage to capture some incredible footage of a baby rhino feeding. And walking with hippo, how to stay alive when you are facing Africa’s biggest killer on foot.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "Parvo Puppy"
programme.desc: A puppy battles a deadly virus in Karratha, a chicken receives a prosthetic leg, and Dr. Lu handles a massive koala crisis on Kangaroo Island.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "A Cyclone hits the Clinic"
programme.desc: Cyclone Damien threatens the Karratha clinic as a dedicated owner risks everything for his dog, and a traveler preps for a desert camel trek.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Unsecured
programme.desc: Bobby, haunted by the infidelity of his ex-wife, enters a new relationship with Lakeisha while grappling with deep-seated insecurities. Unbeknownst to Lakeisha, his past resurfaces when a witness claims to have seen him involved in a murder.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: The Games We Play
programme.desc: Married and settled, Beejay and Montez, are so busy that they have not been intimate in months. When Beejay confesses this detail to her girlfriends, they convince her that all men cheat, and that they can prove it.

programme.title: Back and Forth
programme.desc: Pier and Jade found love though the emotions of skating. Love was built but trust was lost, as deep secrets unfold, back and forth between the UK and USA. Having her heart broken, Jade took her fate in her own hands. It was only a matter of time, that the only plan left was to take revenge.

programme.title: The Walk of Rufus
programme.desc: Eldest son, Rufus, takes over the family empire of running the streets of Chicago, but change comes at a cost.

programme.title: The Walk of Rufus 2: Theodis
programme.desc: Theodis and Rufus are brothers who grow up to become powerful Chicago Kingpins. When rufus is murdered, Theodis sets out on a path of revenge making those responsible for his brother's death pay a high price.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Just Can't Leave You Alone
programme.desc: When a blind date ends in a shootout, Krystal Gray is left with more questions than answers. She discovers a flash drive linked to the murder and a web of secrets involving her brother, a dirty cop, and a mysterious man named Jarrell. As she uncovers the truth, Krystal becomes the target in a deadly game where love and betrayal blur and everyone has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Don't Push That
programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, the action can’t be undone, and it must be repeated every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction. The results are equally fun and chaotic.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo ebrio, pero él la rechaza luego. Graciela busca recuperar su matrimonio con Marcelo, mientras Manuela se declara enemiga de Hortensia y decide abandonar a Ricardo tras un intento de agresión. programme.title: Pecado de Amor

Erasto fuerza a Eustoquio a confesarse culpable de los dólares; Arminda lo culpa. Marisela toma el control total de la empresa de Adolfo. Junior consuela a Rosa y le ofrece trabajo. Blanca recobra más memoria y revela a José Luis que Eustoquio no es ahijado de Erasto sino su hijo. programme.title: Amor Secreto

Paula se entera que Irene está embarazada, y trata de contárselo a Leonardo. Adolfo invita a Jimena a cenar. A Leonardo la familia de Juan Pablo le prohíbe ir al funeral. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres

Paula no logra hablar con Leonardo sobre el embarazo de Irene, así que le da la información a Gloria, quien se la pasa a Rebeca. Irene le comunica a Leonardo que ya firmó la anulación del matrimonio. María Lucía va a hablar con Rodrigo y confirma que es su padre. Virginia acepta cenar con Carlos Ernesto y acude a Zulay y a Sandra para que la ayuden a prepararse. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

Pero Sol envió a hacer otro análisis con la prueba de ADN de Heriberto, y esta prueba también resulta negativa. - Por otro lado, Sol comienza a sospechar que Heriberto tuvo que ver con el atentado que ella sufrió, y que la dejó hospitalizada.

programme.desc: Las historias de cuatro de los naufragios más notables en las costas de Chile durante los siglos XIX y XX, ofrecen una reseña histórica de nuestra identidad como un país remoto y océanico, además de servir como puerto para inmigrantes.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea (Lindsay Lohan), una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses… y pensarse cómo puede salir de esta.

programme.title: Peter Pan: En El Mundo de Nunca Jamás
programme.desc: Nueva y mágica versión de las aventuras de Peter Pan, Campanilla, el Capitán Garfio, Wendy, Michael, John… El país de Nunca Jamás corre un gran peligro a manos del Capitán Garfio. ¿Cumplirá Peter Pan la profecía y salvará al país de Nunca Jamás? ¡Únete a Peter Pan y a sus amigos en sus aventuras!

programme.title: Mi amigo Berni
programme.desc: Sam es un niño muy asustadizo que teme prácticamente cualquier cosa hasta que un día conoce a Bernard, un oso polar que no teme a nada. Bernard se lleva a Sam para participar en una aventura épica que, además de ayudarle a dejar atrás sus miedos, le permite conocer al mayor monstruo de la risa.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse

Para colmo de males, lo han alojado solo en un hotel, mientras el resto de la familia comparte una casa, y su hija quiere que sea su padrastro quien la lleve al altar. Pero conoce a Kate, una peculiar mujer que puede hacer que su viaje a Londres merezca la pena

programme.title: Aborixen
programme.desc: Entre barrancos y naturaleza, fundamentalmente, aprenderemos de un auténtico volcán en erupción, que es Borja Marrero. Un chef con formación académica y gran proyección de futuro. Un pensador y crítico. Un alma viva e hiperactiva, de la que aprenderemos mucho sobre nuestra flora, fauna, así como otros muchos aspectos de la sociedad e historia de Gran Canaria y Canarias en su conjunto.

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan al ficticio Sangyoon para la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde. Eddie y Paige ayudan, pero encuentran problemas y un elefante real; Sin embargo, aún así, el amor verdadero prevalece.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Nivel 16
programme.desc: Thriller distópico sobre una academia que adoctrina a adolescentes imponiendo la pasividad como virtud. Vivien, de 16 años, está atrapada en la Academia Vestalis, un internado que parece una prisión. Su vida cambia al reencontrarse con Sophia, una antigua amiga que la traicionó. Juntas descubren la verdad tras su encarcelamiento y luchan por sobrevivir y escapar.

programme.title: Presa
programme.desc: Una veterinaria de zoo se ve envuelta en una espeluznante aventura al verse al frente de la caza en toda la ciudad de un monstruoso león que aterroriza la capital holandesa de Ámsterdam.

programme.title: La Bahía Del Silencio
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de su esposa e hijos después del traumático nacimiento de su hijo lleva a Will a una búsqueda frenética por Europa para recuperar a su familia y reconstruir su vida. A medida que el misterio detrás de las acciones de su esposa lentamente comienza a tomar una forma oscura y amenazante, Will está decidido a buscar la verdad, sin importar el costo.

programme.title: My Social Network Stalker
programme.desc: Ruth Jeffery fue sometida a abuso emocional y mental a manos de un acosador desconocido que distribuyó fotografías de ella desnuda; Cuando finalmente atraparon al acosador, la identidad del hombre resultó tan traumática como lo que ella ya había soportado.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un conserje acepta limpiar el abandonado parque de atracciones Willy’s Wonderland, pero descubre que sus inquietantes personajes están malditos. Atrapado durante la noche, deberá enfrentarse a ellos en una brutal lucha por la supervivencia llena de acción, humor y terror.

Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Box Yourself
programme.desc: Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!

programme.title: RoboFuse
programme.desc: Rodeo and Booster merge into Robo and set a trap for a rogue UFO that's abducted baby cars from the beach.

programme.title: RoboFuse
programme.desc: Time to merge! A "ghost" has stolen cakes from the cake-eating competition, Rodeo and Booster get ready to stop him.

programme.title: RoboFuse
programme.desc: Rodeo and Booster transform into Robo to catch Zitron after he steals Billy's pipes. Matilda the Police Car helps them.

programme.title: RoboFuse
programme.desc: Zitron deploys his shark minions to scare the crowd at the beach! Rodeo and Booster must save summer!

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: VIP Pets
programme.desc: We are the VIP Pets! The coolest pets with a passion for hair! We are best friends and together we will discover lots of beautiful hairstyles and go on exciting adventures!

programme.title: Om Nom Stories
programme.desc: Sweet tooth Om Nom is wandering Around the world, eats a lot of candies and tries to find his Dream job. Watch his adventures and solve different puzzles on the way!

programme.title: Nutri Ventures
programme.desc: Protecting Healthy Foods At All Costs!

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Everybody Loves a Moose
programme.desc: An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn't! Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can't help being sucked in by Moose's relentless optimism and zest for life!

programme.title: Tom's Car Wash
programme.desc: Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. programme.title: Gods Gang

programme.title: Troy the Train

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large box full of building blocks. He starts building towers, but they keep collapsing whenever he looks away. He discovers a hole in the ground with nothing inside, but curious as ever, he presses a button to inflate himself and blows into one of the holes, causing the troublemaker, a friendly mole, to pop out. Rookie catches his new friend , and together they set up an amazing building.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: In the final episode of the second season, Rookie hears suspicious noises and begins to investigate. But he can‘t find the source! When he finally opens a door, he is greeted by a confetti cannon - a surprise birthday party! All his friends are gathered around a cake with two candles, and at the little turtle’s count, they all join in singing ‘Happy Birthday’ together!

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): State of Shock
programme.desc: After defeating a mysterious group of ninjas at the Emeryville Power Station, the Turtles decode part of a map that they were able to liberate from the would-be thieves.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Cry H.A.V.O.C.!
programme.desc: The Turtles get the drop on masked thieves hijacking a jewellery store, only to have themselves arrested for the crime! Before the turtles can be booked, they are rescued by the mutants Amok and Overdrive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): H.A.V.O.C. in the Streets!
programme.desc: Titanus sends of couple of his H.A.V.O.C.mutants to bust into the aerospace plant and steal some much needed equipment. Only problem is that the Turtles were waiting for them.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Enter: Krakus
programme.desc: Krakus, a cop from the future, arrives and thinking that the Turtles are in league with Titanus, shakes them down for information.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtle Trek
programme.desc: Krang activates his new dimensional portal, thanks to Shredder's installation of the Energy Transmitter at the Power Relay Station, giving him access to Dimension X.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Unknown Ninja
programme.desc: While watching video tapes of old battles, Raphael sees a mystery person spying on them. While the Turtles investigate, an alien warlord named Dregg sends his TechnoGansters to steal all the gold on Earth.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Dregg of the Earth
programme.desc: April contacts the Turtles to let them know that Dregg has landed on Earth and is preparing a press conference. The Turtles rush to meet April at the Park, where they hear Dregg announce his intentions and offers the world his molecular converter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Wrath of Medusa
programme.desc: Believing that the Turtles are the only thing that stands between him and total domination of the planet, Dregg makes contact with Medusa, a sinisterly beautiful alien.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Showdown
programme.desc: April contacts the Turtles to inform them that all the TV stations in the City are jammed. Sleazebug tries to recruit the Turtles for a martial arts tournament.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Split-Second
programme.desc: Carter, April and the Turtles investigate a break-in at the Antique Timepiece Museum. Convinced that Dregg is responsible, the Turtles discover a clue on a wall display.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Carter the Enforcer
programme.desc: Splinter convinces the Turtles that it is their duty to fight evil, even when the whole world is against them. Carter and the Turtles team up with April to get the goods on Dregg.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Return of Dregg
programme.desc: While the Turtles work on using fragments of the Vortex Crystal to stabilize their mutations, Lord Dregg plans to use the fragments to create another Vortex Crystal to power his Vortex Transporter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: While Raphael, Michelangelo, Donatello and Carter work on restoring Leonardo to his regular self, Mung steals all the plutonium from a power plant in order for Dregg to build a Plutonium Ray to turn Leonardo into a radioactive killer.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Power of Three
programme.desc: Mungg informs Dregg that he came across two individuals who claimed they were old acquaintances of the turtles: Shredder and Krang!

programme.title: Orange Carpet All Access: Clash of the Thundermans
programme.desc: Orange Carpet All Access goes behind the scenes of the hotly anticipated new Thundermans movie! Join us on set to meet the cast and find out what's driving the Clash of the Thundermans!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): A Turtle in Time
programme.desc: The Turtles', Shredder's and Krang's battles skills, powers, and memories are absorbed into Dregg.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtles to the Second Power
programme.desc: Dregg and his crew plan an invasion of Earth to make it his new home base, but first he has to get his transporter chip back from Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Day the Earth Disappeared
programme.desc: With the city breaking apart, the Turtles head to the street to investigate and see the Dreggnaut appear in the sky. With Mung's help, Dregg reprograms the transporter to open a warp in space.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Divide and Conquer
programme.desc: Lord Dregg launches a final attack on the Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtle Tracks
programme.desc: April O'Neil, ace reporter for Channel 6, investigates recent break-ins, allegedly by Ninjas, which have resulted in the thefts of numerous technologies.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Enter: The Shredder
programme.desc: The Shredder kidnaps Splinter in an attempt to lure the Turtles to his own cause. In order to rescue Splinter the Turtles must enter the Shredder's mobile fortress and brave its dangerous weaponry.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): A Thing about Rats
programme.desc: Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist, is showing an exterminator his new invention: a rat catching robot called Mousers.

programme.sub-title: Hot Rodding Teenagers from Dimension X
programme.desc: Shredder experiments with the Inter-Dimensional Portal, hoping to contact Krang's' Rock Soldiers and prepare an invasion of Earth.

programme.sub-title: It Came from Beneath the Sewers

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Mean Machines
programme.desc: The hunt for the Eye of Sarnoth continues in the third of a four-parter with the Turtles in Groucho-like disguises. Shredder hooks up a fragment of the Eye to the computer Omnus.

programme.desc: Shredder is in control of the Eye of Sarnoth, enabling him to transmute matter. Shredder brings to life a dragon which soars through the air with shocked shellbacks Leonardo and Michelangelo aboard.

programme.desc: The Turtles' favourite food, pizza, is also the source of their problem. Nasty, fanged creatures have been planted in pizza boxes! When the critters crack open their chrysalises, they become enormous.

programme.desc: Shredder sends April a rare duko plant that renders her unconscious. The Turtles seek a rare leaf that can serve as an antidote.

programme.desc: Mutagen, sent by Krang from Dimension X, changes four Florida frogs into half-human creatures four and a half feet tall. Shredder, training them in his evil ways, names them Attila the Frog, Genghis Frog, Rasputin the Mad Frog and Napoleon Bonafrog.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

Teaming up with locals like Chef Mark "Gooch" Noguchi, Nathan Florence, and Jack Johnson, the DIRT crew dove headfirst into the rugged microclimates and deep-rooted cultures that define the islands. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.
